node.title: Prize N=256 profile-(3,6) cofactor-514 exclusion
node.closure: dual exact radius census plus dual exact norm ledger
node.statement: On prize-envelope N=256 rows, profile-(3,6,S=18) cofactor 514 is impossible. A complete 123196-affine-orbit radius census leaves twelve vectors in the nine live chambers, only eight with factor 257; FLINT and PARI agree that every exact quotient Norm/514 lies below the prize interval.
node.notes: EXACT FINITE EXCLUSION 2026-07-28: hash-map and sorted-pair engines agree on 922886080 XOR probes, 883718 candidate heavy supports, 7069744 exact sign tests, twelve geometric vectors, and eight factor-257 vectors. Seven profile-(3,6) cofactors remain.
